messages:
sara_ml: Quick check — proposal to promote model v2-alpha-q4 (int4, seq-opt) along a phased rollout. Latency p95 = 210ms (prod baseline 200ms). Eval summary: QA-F1 -2.2% abs vs prod on docs-suite, hallucination rate +1.8pp. Suggest phased promotion + concrete auto-fallback thresholds. Feedback?
ben_prod: Can you list concrete pass/fail gates? e.g. max latency +10% p95, QA-F1 drop <=2% abs, hallucination <=1pp?
sara_ml: My proposal:
- Ramp: shadow 1% (48h) -> 5% warm (24h) -> 20% limited (72h) -> full 100% (7d monitor)
- Auto-fallback triggers (immediate rollback): QA-F1 delta <= -2.5% OR hallucination delta >= +2.0pp OR latency p95 >= 260ms (absolute)
- Soft-hold: if QA-F1 delta between -1.5% and -2.5% suspend promotion and trigger review
Also want to gate on signal subsets: long-doc (>4k tokens) and table-extraction tasks.
jordan_research: Recommend adding bucketed gating: if long-doc QA-F1 drops >1.0% OR table-extraction F1 drops >1.5% -> immediate circuit-break.
ivey_oncall: Ops ask: wire SLO alerting. If p99 latency >450ms for >3m then pause rollout and alert oncall. Also include rate-limiting fallback to previous model to avoid cascade.
ben_prod: :thumbsup: Also suggest smoothing for metric comparisons: use 6h rolling median and require sustained breach for 30m to avoid noisy flips.
sara_ml: rollout policy snippet:
```
{
  "model": "v2-alpha-q4",
  "ramp": ["shadow:48h:1%","warm:24h:5%","limited:72h:20%","full:7d:100%"],
  "auto_fallback": {"qa_f1_drop_abs": 2.5, "halluc_pp": 2.0, "p95_latency_ms": 260}
}
```
deploy-bot: canary started: shadow=1% at 2050001240
ivey_oncall: Dashboards configured: /dashboards/model-v2-alpha-q4-rollout. Added synthetic eval run every 30m (long-doc, table-extract). Will post alerts to #eng-oncall and escalation policy.
jordan_research: I'll run ~1k targeted evals on long-doc bucket tonight and report failures in the morning.
sara_ml: Thanks — marking approved pending long-doc results. If no red flags by 2050080000 promote to 5% warm. If any gate trips rollback to v2-stable immediately.
